items.en: `specseal plan` now lists the cuts in discussion conclusions that have no change yet. `plan --json` shows them in a new `unpromotedCuts` key.
items.zh-CN: `specseal plan` 会列出讨论结论中尚未转出的刀，`plan --json` 也多了 `unpromotedCuts` 字段。

items.en: The desktop app now opens `specseal://` links. Another program can send a link to open the detail page of a change or discussion in its project, and the link starts the app if it is not running. On Windows and Linux, a second start of the app now brings the open window to the front.
items.zh-CN: 桌面 app 支持 `specseal://` 网址：其他进程可直接打开某项目的变更或讨论详情页，app 没在运行时会自动启动；Windows、Linux 再次启动 app 时，改为把已开的窗口带到前景。

items.en: The board page now has a roadmap view. It shows each wave as a column, draws the dependencies between changes, and lists the cuts that have no change yet with a button that copies the promote command. The `specseal://roadmap` link opens this view.
items.zh-CN: 看板页添加路线图查看：每一波一栏、画出变更之间的依赖，并列出尚未转出的刀与拷贝转出指令的钮，也能用 `specseal://roadmap` 网址直接打开。

items.en: The new `specseal://project` link switches the desktop app to a project and shows its board. The Logo in the Herdr panel uses this link to open the project of the current space.
items.zh-CN: 添加 `specseal://project` 网址：桌面 app 会切到该项目并显示看板，Herdr 面板的 Logo 用它切到目前 space 的项目。

items.en: A new Herdr mod in `integrations/herdr/` shows the changes and discussions of the current project in a panel. You can dock the panel as a right column or open it as a floating window, and it follows the project of the focused terminal. It needs Herdr 0.1.13 or later.
items.zh-CN: 添加 Herdr mod（`integrations/herdr/`）：用面板显示目前项目的变更与讨论，可停靠在窗口右边一栏或开成浮动窗口，并跟着焦点所在的终端机切换项目，需要 Herdr 0.1.13 以上。

items.en: Each panel row suggests the next skill from the stage and stamps of the change, and one click sends it to the correct agent. The `⋯` button shows the other skills that the row can use. The row also shows the review and verify stamps, and it suggests `worktree-merge` or `archive+commit` when they come next.
items.zh-CN: 面板每一列依阶段和章建议下一个技能，按一下就送给对的 agent，`⋯` 可展开这一列其他能用的技能，列上也会显示审查与验证的章，并在该收尾时建议 `worktree-merge` 或 `archive+commit`。

items.en: The start button opens a new agent in the current space. If the project uses the worktree flow, it first asks whether to use a worktree or run apply directly. The skill dialog (`⌘⇧N`) lets you pick a skill and its changes, then open new tabs or put the command in the input box. A button on each row adds the name to the input box of the current tab.
items.zh-CN: 开工钮会在目前的 space 开新 agent，有开 worktree 流程时先问要用 worktree 还是直接 apply；技能跳窗（`⌘⇧N`）可选技能与搭配的变更，再开新分页或放到输入框；列上的附加钮会把名称接到目前分页的输入框。

items.en: Panel rows show the agent that works on each change or discussion, with its state, and one click jumps to it. An optional Claude Code hook also tracks the commands that you type by hand.
items.zh-CN: 面板列上会显示正在做该变更或讨论的 agent 与状态，点了就切过去，另有选用的 Claude Code hook 可追踪手打的指令。

items.en: The Claude Code `specseal-skills` plugin now reports the current change to Herdr as soon as it knows the change, so the panel stays in sync.
items.zh-CN: Claude Code 的 `specseal-skills` 插件会即时把目前的变更回报给 Herdr，面板就能保持同步。

items.en: The docked layout also connects the left sidebar to Specseal. Project rows in Spaces show the number of changes in each stage. The Agents list groups agents by space and state, and shows the stage and task progress.
items.zh-CN: 停靠版面的左侧栏也接上 Specseal：Spaces 清单依阶段显示变更数量，Agents 清单依 space 和状态分组，并显示阶段与任务进度。

items.en: The panel, the skill dialog, and the built-in Herdr screens follow the system language: Chinese on a Chinese system, and English on other systems.
items.zh-CN: 面板、技能跳窗与 Herdr 内置画面都跟随系统语言：中文系统用中文，其他系统用英文。

items.en: When the current space is not a Specseal project, the panel shows a card with an init button that runs `specseal init` in a new tab.
items.zh-CN: 目前的 space 不是 Specseal 项目时，面板会显示提示卡，按「初始化」就在新分页运行 `specseal init`。

items.en: The discussion detail page, `specseal plan`, and the roadmap now use one rule to find cuts. Bullets that start with `*`, `+`, or a number, and bold text outside a bullet, are no longer cuts and stay in the decision details. With an older server, the page shows no cut section.
items.zh-CN: 讨论详情页、`specseal plan` 与路线图改用同一套方式判定分刀：以 `*`、`+`、编号起头的列点与列点外的粗体段落不再算刀、会留在定案细节，连到旧版 server 时则不显示分刀区段。

items.en: The spec folder is now `specseal/` by default, and the data file of each change is now `.meta.yaml`. After you upgrade, run `specseal update` in an existing `openspec/` project to move it. The update waits and tells you why when other worktrees or uncommitted changes exist. It does not commit for you, and your team should upgrade before they pull the commit. In an OpenSpec project, `specseal init` now imports the project. Projects that you do not move yet still work and show a one-line warning.
items.zh-CN: 规格文档夹缺省改为 `specseal/`、变更数据档改为 `.meta.yaml`：既有的 `openspec/` 项目升级后运行 `specseal update` 就会搬过来（有其他 worktree 或未提交修改时会暂缓并说明原因，搬完要自己 commit，团队成员请先升级再 pull），在 OpenSpec 项目运行 `specseal init` 会直接导入，还没搬的项目照常可用、只多印一行警告。

items.en: The desktop app supports the folder move. When you open an old project, the skill file prompt tells you that `openspec/` becomes `specseal/`. After you click update, the app moves the folder and keeps the board up to date. Enabling an OpenSpec project imports it first. Settings and dialogs show the folder that the project actually uses.
items.zh-CN: 桌面 app 跟上规格文档夹迁移：打开旧项目时，技能档提示会写明 `openspec/` 将改名为 `specseal/`，按下更新后搬好并照常自动更新；「激活」OpenSpec 项目时会先导入；设置页与对话框都照项目实际使用的文档夹显示路径。

items.en: A new built-in workflow, no-spec-change, is for changes that alter no behavior the specs promise. It has no delta spec, `specseal validate` does not warn about a missing delta, and archive does not need `--skip-specs`. `/specseal-propose` picks the workflow for you, and `/specseal-verify` checks that such a change really keeps the promised behavior.
items.zh-CN: 添加内置产出流程 no-spec-change（不改规格），给不改任何正式规格承诺行为的变更使用：没有 delta 规格、`specseal validate` 不再警告缺少 delta、封存不必带 `--skip-specs`，`/specseal-propose` 会替你判断该用哪一个，`/specseal-verify` 会检查这类变更真的没改到承诺的行为。

items.en: The new `specseal change schema <change> <workflow>` command switches the workflow of a change that is not archived yet. When a no-spec-change change turns out to alter promised behavior, `/specseal-ingest` switches it back to spec-driven before it writes the delta spec, and `/specseal-verify` lists the steps to do so. A change without a specs step can no longer get a delta spec by mistake.
items.zh-CN: 添加 `specseal change schema <变更名> <产出流程>`，可以替还没封存的变更换产出流程；不改规格的变更后来改到承诺的行为时，`/specseal-ingest` 会先切回 spec-driven 再补 delta 规格，`/specseal-verify` 的建议也会列出切换步骤，没有 specs 这一步的变更也不会再被误写 delta 规格。

items.en: Review and verify stamps now record how many rounds each gate ran, and archive records the archive time. The time fields of a change are now timestamps to the second with the time zone, but output still shows only the date. The Archived page of the desktop app shows a new "Process cost" summary with the median doc lines, tasks, days and hours from creation to archive, and quality gate rounds.
items.zh-CN: 审查与验证盖章时会记下各自跑了几轮，封存时会记下封存时间，变更的时间字段改为带时区的秒级时戳（输出仍只显示日期）；桌面 app 的已封存页添加「流程成本」摘要，列出文档行数、任务数、创建到封存的天数与小时数，以及品质关卡轮数的中位数。

items.en: Before the first round, `/specseal-quality` now compares your branch with the main branch. If the main branch changed files that this change also changed, it stops and suggests a rebase, so the stamp does not become invalid later. When the repo has CI, the option to stamp now reminds you to wait until CI passes on all platforms.
items.zh-CN: `/specseal-quality` 在第一轮之前会先比对主分支：主分支改过本变更也改过的档时，先停下来建议你 rebase，免得盖章后章失效；repo 有 CI 时，收尾盖章的选项会提醒你先等 CI 在所有平台通过。

items.en: Every skill now tells the agent to talk to you in the language you use, so long skills such as apply and quality no longer switch to English halfway. `locale` still sets only the language of documents and reports, and it now also covers discussion records, the `context` and `rules` that `/specseal-config` writes, and `/specseal-audit` reports. When `locale` is not set, these are in English. Run `specseal update` to get the new skill files.
items.zh-CN: 每个技能都会请 agent 用你说话的语言跟你对话，apply、quality 这类长流程不再中途改讲英文；locale 仍只决定文档与报告的语言，并扩及讨论记录、`/specseal-config` 写入的 context 与 rules，以及 `/specseal-audit` 的报告（未设置 locale 时为英文），运行 `specseal update` 即可取得新的技能档。

items.en: The desktop app has a new window shell. The left side has an icon rail with one tile per project, and a project column. The app draws its own title bar and breadcrumbs on all three platforms. "Add Workspace" is now "New project".
items.zh-CN: 桌面 app 换上新的窗口外壳：左侧是图标列（每个项目一个方块）加上项目栏，三个平台的标题列与面包屑都由 app 自己画，「添加 Workspace」改名为「添加项目」。

items.en: Change and discussion details now open as full detail pages instead of a side panel. The breadcrumbs or Esc take you back to the board, and the board keeps its scroll position, search and filters. Use ‹ n/m › to go to the previous or next item in board order.
items.zh-CN: 变更与讨论的详情从右侧滑出面板改成占满主区的详情页：面包屑或 Esc 回看板，看板的卷动、搜索与筛选原样保留，‹ n／m › 依看板顺序切换上一笔、下一笔。

items.en: Specs and archived items also open as full detail pages. A spec shows each requirement as its own section, with a requirement index and its provenance. To go back, use the back button, ⌘[ (Alt+← on Windows and Linux) or the mouse back button. On macOS, you can also swipe right with two fingers on the trackpad.
items.zh-CN: 规格与已封存项目也改成占满主区的详情页，规格逐条需求分段呈现并附需求目录与溯源；返回钮、⌘[（Windows 与 Linux 为 Alt+←）与鼠标侧键都能回上一页，macOS 也可以用触摸板两指向右滑。

items.en: Detail pages now use a three-column layout like a manual: a document tree on the left, a reading card in the middle, and an "On this page" list on the right in wide windows. The change actions move to the right end of the title bar.
items.zh-CN: 详情页改成手册式三栏：左栏文档树、中间阅读卡、宽窗口时右栏本页目录，变更的动作移到标题列右端。

items.en: The six documents of a change each get their own view. Proposals and designs show section by section, tasks group into cards, delta specs mark modified and removed parts, and the plan and tickets show summary tiles and hints. The manual-task hint lists only the manual tasks that are not checked yet. The source files do not change.
items.zh-CN: 变更的六份文档换上各自的呈现方式：提案与设计逐段排版、任务分群成卡、delta 规格标出修改与移除、调度与工单加上数字砖与提示框，手动任务提示框只列还没勾的项目，源文档案一个字都不改。

items.en: The four documents of a discussion each get their own view. The conclusion splits into the decision, cut cards and rejected options. The discussion log becomes a timeline, and derived changes group by cut.
items.zh-CN: 讨论的结论、讨论过程、背景与衍生变更四份文档换上各自的呈现方式：结论拆成决定、分刀卡与否决列，讨论过程变成时间轴，衍生变更依分刀分组。

items.en: The spec detail page uses the same three-column layout, and the reading card of the Manual page matches the detail pages.
items.zh-CN: 规格详情页换上同一套三栏骨架，手册页的阅读卡也对齐详情页。

items.en: Settings now open in a settings mode. App settings and project settings each list their categories in the left column, with one page per category. New options let you pick a light, dark or system appearance and turn automatic update checks on or off.
items.zh-CN: 设置改成设置模式：应用设置与项目设置各自在左栏列出分类、每类一页，并添加浅色／深色／跟随系统的外观选项与自动检查更新的开关。

items.en: Project context and output rules in project settings now use a code editor with line numbers and highlighting. Project context can switch between edit and preview, and ⌘S saves.
items.zh-CN: 项目设置的项目说明与产出规则改用有行号与上色的代码编辑器，项目说明可以切换编辑与预览，⌘S 保存。

items.en: Settings has a new "About Specseal" page with version information, a button that copies it, links to the source code and issue reports, and the licenses. "About Specseal" in the macOS menu opens this page.
items.zh-CN: 设置添加「关于 Specseal」页，提供版本信息与一键拷贝、原代码与回报问题链接和授权条款，macOS 菜单的「关于 Specseal」直接开这一页。

items.en: On macOS, the desktop app has its own menu bar. It follows the interface language and has shortcuts to open a project, switch pages, search the board and check for updates. A new "Keyboard Shortcuts" card in Settings lists the shortcuts that work on your platform.
items.zh-CN: macOS 有了跟着接口语言的原生菜单列，提供打开项目、切页、搜索看板、检查更新等快捷键，设置页添加「键盘快捷键」卡，列出你的平台实际生效的快捷键。

items.en: On Windows, a left click on the system tray icon opens the same panel as on macOS. A right click still opens the native menu.
items.zh-CN: Windows 的系统匣图标左键改开与 macOS 相同的面板，右键保留原生菜单。

items.en: A project can write its own review rules and severities in openspec/config.yaml. `/specseal-review` grades findings by these rules, and `/specseal-config` and the desktop settings help you keep them.
items.zh-CN: 项目可以在 openspec/config.yaml 写下自己的审查规则与严重度，`/specseal-review` 依这些规则定级，`/specseal-config` 与桌面设置页协助维护。

items.en: A review ticket records the review rules that the first round used. The Review tab in the desktop app shows which rules the review followed.
items.zh-CN: 审查工单记下首轮套用的审查规则，桌面 app 的「审查」分页显示这次依哪些规则判定。

items.en: `specseal init` and `specseal update` can install skills for GitHub Copilot. The skills go to `.github/skills/` and use the Copilot command syntax.
items.zh-CN: `specseal init` 与 `specseal update` 可以选 GitHub Copilot，技能写到 `.github/skills/` 并使用 Copilot 的叫用语法。

items.en: New Claude Code plugin specseal-skills, with this repo as its marketplace. A row of colored skill tabs marks the current step and change. A side panel has Board, Discussions and Quality tabs. Type # in the prompt to pick a proposed change, and the skill row wraps to three rows in a narrow terminal.
items.zh-CN: 添加 Claude Code 插件 specseal-skills（这个 repo 就是它的 marketplace）：彩色的技能列标出目前的步骤与变更，侧边面板分看板、讨论、品质三分页，在输入框打 # 可以选取提案中的变更，终端机太窄时技能列改成三列。

items.en: The changelog is now in English and Traditional Chinese. The repo has an English CHANGELOG.md and a Traditional Chinese CHANGELOG.zh-CN.md. The GitHub Release notes show English first, with the Chinese text in a collapsed section. The desktop app shows the entries in your interface language.
items.zh-CN: 更新日志改成中英双语：repo 有英文 CHANGELOG.md 与繁中 CHANGELOG.zh-CN.md，GitHub Release 说明英文在前、繁中收合，桌面 app 依接口语言显示条目。

items.en: Specseal has a new joined "S" logo and a wordmark for dark backgrounds.
items.zh-CN: Specseal 改用新的接合 S 标志，并添加深色背景用的字标。

items.en: The server console no longer uses a side drawer. Users and projects open as detail pages with their own URLs, which you can reload or share. Invite, create and rename actions open a dialog in the center of the screen, and the dialog shows the invite link or the key directly.
items.zh-CN: server 后台拿掉右侧抽屉：用户与项目改成有自己网址、可以刷新与分享的详情页，邀请、创建与更名改在画面中央的对话框，邀请链接与密钥明文直接显示在对话框里。

items.en: The server now blocks every write from the reader role, from the CLI and from the desktop remote board. Content in a wrong format gets a 400 response that tells you what is wrong, not an internal server error.
items.zh-CN: server 一律挡下 reader 角色的写入（CLI 与桌面远程看板都一样），送出格式错误的内容时回 400 并说明哪里不合格式，不再显示服务器内部错误。

items.en: In the English interface, counts now use the singular for one item, for example "1 scenario". English labels in the status rows of detail pages no longer overlap the values.
items.zh-CN: 英文接口的计数依数量用单数或复数（例如「1 scenario」），详情页状态栏的英文标签不再压到数值。

items.en: When you open a change or a discussion from the system tray, the app first closes any dialog in the main window. The dialog and the details no longer show on top of each other.
items.zh-CN: 从系统匣打开变更或讨论时，主窗口上开着的对话框会先关掉，不再和详情叠在一起。

items.en: You can give `/specseal-ingest` the name of the change to update.
items.zh-CN: `/specseal-ingest` 的参数可以直接指定要更新哪个变更。

items.en: The desktop app, the server console and the shared components have a new visual style: white surfaces with neutral grays, thin borders and flat components. Markdown uses a new renderer.
items.zh-CN: 桌面 app、server 后台与共用组件换上新的视觉风格：白底中性灰、细框、扁平的组件，markdown 也改用新的渲染器。

items.en: Board columns and cards are now white containers with thin borders. Search and filters move to the page header, and the discussion column remembers if "Promoted" is open.
items.zh-CN: 看板的栏与卡片换成白底细框的容器卡，搜索框与筛选移到页标题区，讨论栏记住「已转出」的展开状态。

items.en: The Specs, Archived and Manual pages now show lists with a paging toolbar. You can jump to a page and pick the page size, and the app remembers the page size after a restart.
items.zh-CN: 规格、已封存与手册页换成列式清单与换页工具列，可以跳页、选每页笔数，每页笔数在重新启动后保留。

items.en: The notice about outdated skill files moves to a card at the bottom of the project column. When a new version is available, an update button shows in the icon rail, and you can download and install from it.
items.zh-CN: 技能档过期的提示改放在项目栏底部的提示卡，有新版本时图标列出现更新钮，点开就能下载与安装。

items.en: The system tray panel uses the same white cards as the main window.
items.zh-CN: 系统匣面板换成与主窗口同一套白卡外观。

items.en: The system tray panel shows the Proposed, In progress and Ready sections first. Content cards can collapse, and the frosted-glass effect on macOS is back.
items.zh-CN: 系统匣面板把提案中、进行中、已就绪三个分区移到最前面，内容卡可以收合，macOS 的毛玻璃效果也回来了。

items.en: Promoted discussions in the system tray panel have their own card, so you can tell them apart from open discussions at a glance.
items.zh-CN: 系统匣面板的已转出讨论改成独立一张卡，与讨论中的清单一眼分得开。

items.en: Clickable items now give the same feedback everywhere. The desktop app keeps the arrow cursor and shows a hover background. The server console uses the hand cursor. Disabled and read-only items have no hover effect.
items.zh-CN: 可点的元素有一致的光标与滑过回馈：桌面 app 维持箭头并以底色提示可点，server 后台用手指光标，停用与唯读的元素没有滑过效果。

items.en: Review and verify stamps on a detail page show only in the Quality gates row of the left status area, not again in the header.
items.zh-CN: 详情页的审查与验证章签只放在左栏状态区的「品质关卡」列，不再在身分区重复出现。

items.en: Summary tiles on a reading card share the full row width equally, and the discussion log lists rounds from newest to oldest.
items.zh-CN: 阅读卡的数字砖依格数平分整列，讨论过程改成由新到旧排列。

items.en: Task rows open or close by their check state: unchecked tasks are open and checked tasks are closed.
items.zh-CN: 任务文档的任务列依勾选状态展开：没勾的展开、勾完的收合。

items.en: The step bar on a discussion detail page uses the same color as its status tag, and the conclusion marks the cuts that are not promoted yet.
items.zh-CN: 讨论详情页的步骤列与状态签同色同义，结论文档标出还没转出的刀。

items.en: The server console shell, page headers and the sign-in, setup, invite and device sign-in pages now look like the desktop app.
items.zh-CN: server 后台的外壳、页标题与登录、初始设置、接受邀请、设备登录四页改成与桌面 app 相同的样子。

items.en: The server console list pages, audit log and settings pages use the list and settings parts of the desktop app. The overview starts with four summary tiles, and revoke buttons show only when the pointer is on that row.
items.zh-CN: server 后台的列表页、稽核纪录与设置型页改用桌面 app 的清单与设置组件，总览顶端改成四格数字砖，撤销钮只在鼠标移入该列时出现。

items.en: Each quality-station round now runs only the affected tests and starts its three subagents at the same time, so a round waits about 40 minutes less. After a worktree merge, the stations no longer ask for `--base` every time.
items.zh-CN: 品质关卡每一轮只跑受影响的测试、三个子代理同时派出，每轮少等约 40 分钟，worktree 合并后也不再每次被问 `--base`。

items.en: The 19 skills now follow one writing guide for all models. The rules are shorter and do not repeat, so models from Claude, Codex and Copilot follow them more easily.
items.zh-CN: 19 个技能依同一份跨模型的写法规范重写，规则更短、不重复，Claude、Codex 与 Copilot 的模型都更容易照做。

items.en: `/specseal-config` confirms all policy settings in one table. Review rules are optional, and the skill helps you decide if a rule belongs in review rules or in output rules.
items.zh-CN: `/specseal-config` 改用一张表确认全部政策，审查规则改成选用，并协助判断一条规矩该放审查规则还是产出规则。

items.en: When you write review rules and your skill files are older than the engine, the CLI tells you to update them first. The `--dry-run` diff marks only the lines that really change.
items.zh-CN: 写入审查规则时，技能档比引擎旧会提醒你先更新，`--dry-run` 的差异只标出真的改动的行。

items.en: The README is now an English-first open-source home page. The Chinese version is README.zh-CN.md, and the repo adds CONTRIBUTING, SECURITY and issue templates.
items.zh-CN: README 改成英文为主的开源首页，繁中版改名为 README.zh-CN.md，并添加 CONTRIBUTING、SECURITY 与 issue 模板。

items.en: `specseal plan` now builds waves from declared dependencies only. When two changes touch the same capability, plan no longer pushes one of them back. A small change with no dependencies can start at once. When two changes touch the same requirement, plan shows the archive order (which change waits for the other to archive) and name conflicts. The archive and commit skills warn you before an archive. After an archive, they name the later changes that must first rewrite against the specs. Changes with no board order now sort by dependent count, task count and creation time. The new `specseal change rank` puts a change before or after another one. At the end of propose and ingest, the skills move small, urgent changes up. To use the old algorithm, add `--strict-overlap` (local only).
items.zh-CN: `specseal plan` 的波次改成只看声明的依赖，两个变更动到同一个 capability 不再把其中一个推到后面，没有依赖的小变更可以马上开工；两个变更动到同一个 requirement 时，plan 改为标出封存顺序（谁要等谁先封存）与同名冲突，archive 与 commit 技能封存前会提醒、封存后会点名排在后面的变更先对照正式规格重写；没有看板顺序的变更改依被依赖数、任务数与创建时间排，添加的 `specseal change rank` 可以把变更排到另一个之前或之后，propose 与 ingest 收尾会替小而急的变更插队；要用旧算法时加 `--strict-overlap`（只限本机）。

items.en: The Plan tab in the desktop app detail panel now shows four cards: Wave, Prerequisites, Overlaps and Archive order. A badge on the Prerequisites card shows if the change is blocked. The Overlaps card lists which change touches which requirement, and what each side does to it. The Archive order card lists the changes that must archive first. The cards show a warning for a name conflict or a mutual wait. Remote projects show the same information. With an older server, the Prerequisites card also lists the waits that the server finds from overlaps.
items.zh-CN: 桌面 app 详情面板的「调度」分页改成波次、前置、重叠、封存顺序四张卡片：是否被卡住改成前置卡上的徽章，重叠卡列出和哪个变更撞到哪个 requirement、双方各做了什幺操作，封存顺序卡列出封存时要排在谁后面，遇到同名冲突或互相等待时显示警示；remote 项目也看得到同一份信息，连到旧版 server 时前置卡会另列 server 依重叠判定的等待。

items.en: While a review or verification is in progress, the change detail panel in the desktop app shows Review and Verify tabs. They show the findings that hold up the ticket. Each round can collapse, and the last round is open. Each finding shows its severity, path and description, and accepted findings carry an Accepted tag. The tabs go away when the ticket gets its stamp or you discard it. If an archived change did not pass review or verification, you can still see the ticket that it took into the archive.
items.zh-CN: 桌面 app 的变更详情面板在审查或验证进行中时，多出「审查」「验证」分页，直接看到工单里卡了哪些 findings：每轮可收合、最后一轮展开，每条 finding 标严重度、路径与描述，已接受的标「已接受」签；工单盖章或放弃后分页自动消失。已封存的变更若曾审查或验证未通过，也能看到带走的工单。

items.en: `/specseal-discuss` now writes conclusions as lists. The Decision starts with a one-sentence verdict, then one point per line. Rejected alternatives and Deferred give each option and its reason on one line. Each cut that the discussion promotes gets its own bullet. The Conclusion tab in the desktop app no longer shows long blocks of text. Older discussion records stay as they are.
items.zh-CN: `/specseal-discuss` 写结论时改用条列：Decision 一句定论起头、其后一点一行，Rejected alternatives 与 Deferred 每项一行写方案与理由，分几刀转出就每刀一个 bullet；桌面 app 的结论分页因此不再出现整段长句。旧的讨论记录不会被改写。

items.en: `specseal plan` calculates the execution order of all changes that are not archived. It groups them into waves (changes in the same wave can run in parallel), lists what blocks each change, and names the next change that is ready to start. `specseal change depends` declares which changes must finish before a change. The apply skill checks plan before it starts and stops when the change is blocked. At the end of propose, the skill records the dependencies that it finds.
items.zh-CN: `specseal plan` 会算出所有未封存变更的运行顺序：分成一波一波（同一波可以并行），列出每个变更被谁卡住，并指出下一个可开工的变更；`specseal change depends` 可以声明「这个变更要等哪些变更先做完」，apply 技能开工前会先看 plan、被卡住就停下，propose 收尾会把判定出的依赖落档。

items.en: The board, the system tray and the detail panel in the desktop app follow the plan order. Cards show their wave, and blocked changes appear faded. A new Plan tab in the detail panel shows the prerequisites and lets you add or remove them. Drag-and-drop cannot move a card past a declared dependency. The board shows a warning when dependencies form a cycle.
items.zh-CN: 桌面 app 的看板、系统匣与详情面板都照 plan 的顺序排列：卡片标出波次、被卡住的变更变淡，详情面板添加「调度」分页可以查看与增减前置，拖排不能跨越声明的依赖，依赖成环时看板会提示。

items.en: Remote mode has the same execution order. The server provides plan and writes prerequisites. When the desktop app connects to a server, its board and system tray work the same as locally, and so does the CLI in remote mode. When you add a prerequisite in the Plan tab, the candidates now come from the roster that holds the change. A change in a worktree no longer offers names that the engine rejects.
items.zh-CN: remote 模式也有同一套运行顺序：server 提供 plan 与前置写入，桌面连 server 的看板、系统匣与 CLI 的 remote 模式行为与本机一致；调度分页添加前置的候选改取自该变更所在的名册，worktree 内的变更不会再选到被引擎拒绝的名字。

items.en: After an archive, the archive and commit skills point to the next change that is ready to start. The "archive first, then commit together" flow of the commit skill now suggests an order before it archives and warns you when the manual is out of date.
items.zh-CN: 封存完成后，archive 与 commit 技能会提示「下一个可开工」的变更；commit 技能的「先封存再一起提交」子流程补上封存前的顺序建议与手册过期提醒。

items.en: apply-with-worktree checks plan before it creates a worktree. With several change names, it separates the changes that can run in parallel from the changes that must wait for prerequisites. A blocked change no longer leaves an empty worktree behind. At the end of ingest, the skill checks the dependencies of the change again and records them.
items.zh-CN: apply-with-worktree 建 worktree 之前先以 plan 守门：多个变更名时分出可并行与须等前置的，被卡住的变更不会留下空 worktree；ingest 收尾会重判本变更的依赖并落档。

items.en: The opening scan of `/specseal-discuss` now includes the delta specs of changes in progress. The list of assumptions marks the requirements that "in-progress change X will change". A discussion no longer builds on specs that are about to change. Each change in `specseal list --json` now carries the list of capabilities in its delta.
items.zh-CN: `/specseal-discuss` 开场侦察纳入进行中变更的 delta 规格：假设清单会标出「进行中变更 X 将改动」哪些需求，避免讨论创建在正被改掉的规格上；`specseal list --json` 每笔变更多带 delta 的 capability 清单。

items.en: When a skill file notice appears (instruction files out of date, missing or newer), the bottom of the window no longer cuts off the board, the specs page, the manual page and the archived page. Each column scrolls to the end and shows the last card and the pagination bar at the bottom.
items.zh-CN: 技能档提示（指令档过期、缺失或较新）出现时，看板、规格页、手册页与已封存页不再被窗口底缘裁掉，每栏卷到底可以看到最后一张卡与沉底的换页控制列。

items.en: On macOS, when you click a change row in the system tray panel to bring up the main window, hover effects, cursor styles and tooltips no longer stop working. The panel closes before the main window opens.
items.zh-CN: macOS 从系统匣面板点变更列唤起主窗口后，hover、光标样式与提示文本不再全部失效；面板会先收合再显示主窗口。

items.en: A global CLI install with Yarn keeps the shim file, so the CLI runs after the install. The Homebrew formula now takes its checksum from the npm registry, so a release rerun stays in sync with the registry. On musl Linux, install.sh tells you that it supports only glibc.
items.zh-CN: 用 Yarn 全域安装 CLI 时保留转接档，安装后可正常运行；Homebrew formula 的校验值改自 npm registry 取回，重跑发版不会与 registry 脱节；install.sh 在 musl Linux 上说明只支持 glibc。

items.en: The Release page now has 6 files instead of 21: one universal macOS dmg for both Apple Silicon and Intel, the Windows installer, Linux AppImages for two architectures, and the .app.tar.gz and latest.json files for automatic updates. The CLI now comes from one source on npm. `npm i -g @specseal/cli` installs the native executable, and Homebrew and `install.sh` get the same package. A Linux machine without a graphical interface can install the CLI with one curl line. The Linux desktop build no longer ships a .deb. If you use the .deb, remove it and install the AppImage.
items.zh-CN: Release 页从 21 个档收成 6 个：macOS 一个 universal dmg 同时跑 Apple Silicon 与 Intel、Windows 安装器、Linux 两种架构的 AppImage，加上自动更新用的 .app.tar.gz 与 latest.json；CLI 改由 npm 单一来源供给——`npm i -g @specseal/cli` 装到的是原生运行档，Homebrew 与 `install.sh` 抓的是同一份套件，无图形接口的 Linux 也能 curl 一行装好；Linux 桌面版不再出 .deb，既有 .deb 用户请移除后改装 AppImage。

items.en: The desktop app checks for updates again when its window comes to the front. If you keep the app open for a long time, it still finds new versions. You do not need to click "Check for Updates" in Settings.
items.zh-CN: 桌面 app 的窗口回到前景时会重新检查更新，长时间开着 app 也能发现新版本，不必再到设置页手动按「检查更新」。

items.en: When you promote a discussion into changes in several cuts, add `--last` to the last cut. `discuss promote`, `new change --from-discussion` and `discuss seal` all accept it. When the last change goes to the archive, the discussion record goes with it. You no longer need to run `specseal discuss archive` by hand.
items.zh-CN: 一份讨论分多刀转出变更时，最后一刀带 `--last`（`discuss promote`、`new change --from-discussion`、`discuss seal` 都收），最后一个变更封存后讨论记录自动随行封存，不用再手动跑 `specseal discuss archive`。

items.en: The Traditional Chinese text now uses one term, 「正式规格」, for the specs that archive merges. It pairs with 「delta 规格」 in a change. The specs page and the manual in the desktop app, the README and the docs use the same words. The English text keeps "specs".
items.zh-CN: 封存后合并的规格在繁中统一叫「正式规格」，与变更里的「delta 规格」成对；桌面 app 的规格页、手册、README 与文档同步改字，英文维持 specs。

items.en: Each release has a plain-language changelog. The repo adds CHANGELOG.md. After an update, the desktop app shows "What's new in X.Y.Z" on the first launch. You can open it again from "Changelog" in Settings.
items.zh-CN: 每个 release 版本都有白话的更新日志：repo 添加 CHANGELOG.md，桌面 app 更新后首次启动会弹出「X.Y.Z 更新内容」，之后也能从设置页的「更新日志」再看一次。

items.en: `specseal validate` finds early the deltas that archive rejects: a target requirement that does not exist, a name collision, or a removed scenario that is not declared. You no longer find them only at archive time.
items.zh-CN: `specseal validate` 提早抓出封存时会被拒收的 delta（目标需求不存在、撞名、少声明移除的 scenario），不用做到封存才发现。

items.en: A manual page can anchor its source to one requirement in a spec. The archive of another section no longer marks the whole page "Possibly outdated". When a regenerated page has the same text, only its timestamp changes.
items.zh-CN: 手册页的出处可以只锚定规格里的一段需求，别段的封存不会再把整页标成「可能过期」；重生后内文没变的页只换时戳。

items.en: `/specseal-improve` adds a sixth friction signal: the grouping of folders and modules gets its own entry criteria.
items.zh-CN: `/specseal-improve` 添加第六条摩擦信号：文档夹与模块的分组整理有了自己的准入判准。

items.en: `specseal analyze` drops four false positives. It no longer asks you to copy a full design heading into tasks, and it no longer asks for scenarios in REMOVED blocks. The rules for the four dimensions are now part of the spec.
items.zh-CN: `specseal analyze` 收敛四条误报：design 标题不再要求整串抄进 tasks，REMOVED 区块不再要求 scenario；四个面向的规则正式写进规格。

items.en: A discussion that you keep open with `--hold` no longer loses its flag when you promote the next cut. It also does not go into the archive with the change. The board shows these discussions apart from the "promoted" discussions. To close one out, run `specseal discuss archive`.
items.zh-CN: 用 `--hold` 保留在途的讨论，转出下一刀时不再被清掉旗标、也不会被连带封存；看板上与「已转出」的讨论分开呈现，收尾由 `specseal discuss archive` 明示解除。

items.en: `specseal archive --mark-tasks-complete` no longer checks every box in tasks.md when it rejects the archive of a change with a structure that is not valid.
items.zh-CN: `specseal archive --mark-tasks-complete` 遇到结构不合法的变更时，封存被拒也不会再把 tasks.md 全勾。

items.en: A status update to a discussion record now changes only the frontmatter. The same string in the body no longer changes by mistake. During an archive, an active change with damaged meta now gets careful handling, so a discussion does not go into the archive by mistake.
items.zh-CN: 讨论记录的状态改写只动 frontmatter，内文出现相同字符串不再被误改；封存时对 meta 损坏的在途变更改成保守处理，讨论不会被误扫进封存区。

items.en: The release flow now polls for a newly published npm package. A registry delay no longer looks like a failure.
items.zh-CN: 发版流程对刚上架的 npm 套件改成轮询查找，不再因 registry 延迟可见而误判失败。

items.en: New `/specseal-manual` skill: with one sentence, it generates a wiki-style manual for new team members from the specs. It can also give you a tour of the system in the conversation.
items.zh-CN: 添加 `/specseal-manual` 技能：一句话就能从正式规格生成 wiki 式的新人手册，或让 AI 在对话中带你导览系统。

items.en: New Manual page in the desktop app: the sidebar tree, the search and the previous/next links come from the manual pages automatically. The page marks the pages that may be out of date.
items.zh-CN: 桌面 app 添加「手册」页：侧栏树、搜索与上一页／下一页由手册页自动推导，可能过期的页面会标示出来。

items.en: New `specseal trace` verb and `/specseal-trace` skill: they follow "spec → change → discussion → code" to tell you how a feature came to be and why it works this way.
items.zh-CN: 添加 `specseal trace` 动词与 `/specseal-trace` 技能：沿「规格 → 变更 → 讨论 → 代码」回答某个功能怎幺来的、为什幺这样设计。

items.en: New `specseal discuss search`: it finds the decisions in archived discussions by keyword. The discuss and improve skills check old discussions when they start, so they do not bring back rejected directions.
items.zh-CN: 添加 `specseal discuss search`：依关键字找出封存讨论里的定案；discuss 与 improve 技能开场会先查旧讨论，不再重提已否决的方向。

items.en: `discuss conclude --hold` keeps a discussion open, so one discussion can promote several changes over time.
items.zh-CN: 讨论可用 `discuss conclude --hold` 保留在途，一份讨论可以分期转出多个变更。

items.en: The conclusion now controls the life cycle of a discussion. A discussion without a conclusion does not go into the archive with a change. The board shows discussions that are "promoted but not concluded" as a separate group.
items.zh-CN: 讨论的生命周期改由结论决定：还没写结论的讨论不会被连带封存，看板也分得出「已转出但未结论」的讨论。

items.en: "Add Workspace" in the desktop app remembers the workspaces that you opened recently. After you close a tab, you can open the workspace again with one click.
items.zh-CN: 桌面 app 的「添加 Workspace」记住最近开过的 workspace，分页关掉之后也能一键再开。

items.en: New Workflow tab in the desktop app settings: view, switch, fork, create and delete workflow schemas.
items.zh-CN: 桌面 app 设置页添加「产出流程」页签：查看、切换、fork、创建与删除产出流程。

items.en: The provenance tags in the spec, change and discussion drawers of the desktop app are all clickable. You can go from spec to change to discussion and back in three steps.
items.zh-CN: 桌面 app 的规格、变更与讨论抽屉的溯源签都可以点：规格 → 变更 → 讨论三跳闭环。

items.en: Claims in remote mode now save for real. The desktop remote board can claim a change and shows who works on it.
items.zh-CN: 远程模式的认领真正落盘：桌面远程看板可以认领变更，并看到是谁在做。

items.en: When you check off a task in remote mode, the server keeps the evidence of the touched files. Drift, commit and archive provenance can find it later.
items.zh-CN: 远程模式勾任务时，触及文档的证据会保存到 server，之后 drift、commit 与封存溯源都查得到。

items.en: `@specseal/engine` is now on npm. You can use the engine in your own scripts without a Rust toolchain.
items.zh-CN: `@specseal/engine` 发布到 npm：不用自备 Rust 工具链，就能把引擎接进自己的脚本。

items.en: createEngine in the Node SDK can take an operator identity and provides stamp verbs. Stamps in multi-user systems are no longer anonymous.
items.zh-CN: Node SDK 的 createEngine 可以注入操作者身分并提供盖章动词，多人系统的章不再匿名。

items.en: When you open a new capability, Specseal blocks a duplicate name and suggests similar names. You no longer get two specs with the same meaning.
items.zh-CN: 新开 capability 时挡下重复命名并建议近似名，不会再产出两份语意重复的规格。

items.en: `specseal init --force` removes the skill directory of the previous tool when you switch tools. The notice for stale skill files also covers custom descriptors.
items.zh-CN: `specseal init --force` 切换工具时会清掉前一个工具的技能目录；技能档过期提示也涵盖自订描述子。

items.en: The "Possibly outdated" check for manual pages now compares timestamps. A manual that you regenerate right after an archive no longer gets that mark by mistake.
items.zh-CN: 手册页的「可能过期」判定改比到时戳，封存后立刻重生的手册不再被误标。

items.en: Lines that start with "## " in a discussion record no longer mix up the rounds, and they no longer count as the conclusion.
items.zh-CN: 讨论记录内文含「## 」开头的行时，轮次不再错乱，也不会被误当成结论。

items.en: Review and verification in remote mode now read the evidence on the server. They no longer stop and ask for manual input when no local evidence file exists.
items.zh-CN: 远程模式的审查与验证改读 server 上的证据，不再因本机没有证据档而卡住要求手动输入。

items.en: The baseline skill applies the specs output rules in config.yaml.
items.zh-CN: baseline 技能会套用 config.yaml 里的 specs 产出规则。

items.en: The remote board now shows the creator, the start owner, the capability list and the group for promoted discussions.
items.zh-CN: 远程看板补齐创建者、开工归属、capability 清单与已转出讨论的分区。

items.en: Change rows in the system tray panel now show the worktree marker.
items.zh-CN: 系统匣面板的变更列补上 worktree 标记。

items.en: Quality station stamps support scope files that are not UTF-8.
items.zh-CN: 品质关卡的章支持非 UTF-8 的范围档。

items.en: The onboard skill is now baseline (`/specseal-baseline`), to keep it apart from Onboard in OpenSpec.
items.zh-CN: onboard 技能改名为 baseline（`/specseal-baseline`），与 OpenSpec 的 Onboard 区隔。

items.en: The handoff lines at the end of skills are clearer. After propose, they check the execution order. After apply, they say that you can archive directly. The worktree wrap-up lists `/specseal-quality`. After archive, they remind you to commit.
items.zh-CN: 技能收尾的交棒句更清楚：propose 后盘点运行顺序、apply 后可以直接封存、worktree 收尾列出 `/specseal-quality`、archive 后提醒提交。

items.en: Skill routing now lives in the description and the handoff lines of each skill. Specseal no longer injects a marker.
items.zh-CN: 技能路由改由 description 与交棒句承载，不再注入 marker。

items.en: The discuss skill has a new flow. It reads the specs first and then scouts. It picks a path by how clear the requirements are. Discussions with several requirements follow a fixed convention.
items.zh-CN: discuss 技能流程重写：先读正典再侦察、依需求清晰度分流、多需求讨论有固定惯例。

items.en: The built-in workflow schemas now come down to one canonical schema. Its validation strength matches OpenSpec.
items.zh-CN: 内置产出流程收敛为单一正典，验证强度对齐 OpenSpec。

items.en: The apply instructions payload now carries the effective TDD and audit values directly. The old policy keys no longer work.
items.zh-CN: apply 指令的 payload 直接带 TDD 与 audit 的有效值，旧的政策键不再兼容。

items.en: The source card in "Add Workspace" in the desktop app now has the name "Server", without the brand prefix.
items.zh-CN: 桌面「添加 Workspace」的来源卡改称「Server」，去掉品牌前缀。
